oneTimers: Currency gain: 'interest and other income' includes a $43M non-cash unrealized gain from F/X remeasurement on Netflix's euro-denominated debt — a paper gain below operating income, not revenue from running the service.
otherDetail: Interest expense of $168M on Netflix's debt, partly offset by $79M of interest and other income — including a $43M non-cash unrealized gain from F/X remeasurement on its euro-denominated debt — a net -$89M below operating profit.

segments.name: United States & Canada
segments.note: The biggest and richest market — 84.11M paid memberships after 1.45M net additions, with revenue per member of $17.17 a month, up 7% year over year.

segments.name: Europe, Middle East & Africa
segments.note: The second-largest region — 93.96M paid memberships after 2.24M net additions; revenue per member was $10.80 a month, down 1% year over year as reported but up 1% on an F/X-neutral basis.

segments.name: Latin America
segments.note: 49.25M paid memberships after 1.53M net additions; revenue per member was $8.28 a month, down 3% as reported but up 24% on an F/X-neutral basis, reflecting large peso price increases in Argentina and the peso's devaluation.

segments.name: Asia-Pacific
segments.note: The most net additions of any region — 2.83M added to reach 50.32M paid memberships; revenue per member was $7.17 a month, down 6% year over year.

sources.label: Official earnings release — shareholder letter (SEC EDGAR)

takeaways.text: Netflix added 8.05M paid memberships, up from 5.89M a year ago, to end the quarter at 277.65M — paid memberships were up 16.5% year over year, with Asia-Pacific adding the most members (2.83M).
takeaways.title: Member growth stayed strong

takeaways.text: Operating income rose 42% year over year to $2.6B on revenue growth of 17% — the operating margin reached 27.2%, five points better than 22.3% a year ago, and net income rose 44% to $2.1B.
takeaways.title: Profit grew much faster than revenue

takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $1.2B in the quarter, and Netflix raised its full-year 2024 outlook to revenue growth of 14% to 15% (from 13% to 15%) and an operating margin of 26% (from 25%).
takeaways.title: Cash flow, and a higher full-year bar

verdict: Netflix added 8.1M members and grew revenue 17% to $9.6B, and because costs grew far more slowly than sales, operating income jumped 42% to $2.6B and net income rose 44% to $2.1B.
